sourceReview.P02: All public model properties/initializers, enums, action signatures and component entry points match the public schema. Immutable typed inputs are accepted by the supplied bridges.
sourceReview.P03: Effective selections and the ordered gate are computed from each model. No remembered business state, model mutations, timer or implicit transitions exist. Irrelevant size/acknowledgement fields are excluded from submit.
sourceReview.P04: Status-specific branches remove editing, submitting or result controls from the view tree as required; header, item and summary persist.
sourceReview.P01/P05: Natural-height containers and text with no line limit; fixed minimum targets only. Amounts use trailing-aligned separate lines. System fonts/native scaling and directional leading/trailing layouts. Colors and geometry use the public tokens.
sourceReview.P06: Production identifiers, button/radio/checkbox selection/enabled semantics, heading traits, decorative hiding, notes state and progress busy value are declared. Runtime AX coverage is limited to the single public example integration.

limitations: No screenshots/images opened during D0. Color, clipping and visual layout remain unassessed.
Only the public-example integration is executed. Long arbitrary text, other widths, dark/RTL and enlarged native type are not runtime tested in D0.
Minimum deployment compatibility is established by Swift 5 package-source typecheck targeting iOS 14/macOS 11, not execution on those OS releases.

The immutable baseline Android observer source paints its host background with #EDF1F6/#0D1420 instead of the public demonstration host colors. Component card colors are independent; no production adaptation was made.
